500 - Internal Server Error
THE SERVER HAS ENCOUNTERED AN INTERNAL ERROR OR MISCONFIGURATION
You may have reached this page due to a URL that has recently changed on the uwyo.edu website. You can attempt to search for the page you are looking for and follow these steps below.
If possible, please notify the UW department where the broken link was located.
Determine where the broken link was located. This is typically within a UW website (such as a webpage, WyoWeb or another UW o nline resource).
If the link you clicked was on a page housed within the www.uwyo.edu website, scroll to the bottom of that original page to locate the department's contact information.
If you cannot find contact information for a UW department or page, please use our A - Z directory to find the unit you are looking for.
When contacting a department, be sure to include the page(s) in which the broken link was located, along with the URL of the broken link itself that will be shown inside your web browser's URL bar. This is important information so they can identify and fix the issue.
